title: Book that foretold the Texas Tower sniper

tellings.quote: >> And there was there was a book that uh talked about the Texas Tower sniper before it ever happened.

plain: A book described the Texas Tower sniper, a gunman who shot people from a tower in Texas in 1966, before it ever happened. The researcher Peter Levenda says so but does not name the book. He brings it up as an example of a story that seems to have seen the future.
